recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not make a redundant FHIR-14212 source edit; any future clarification of multiple dose/rate semantics or examples should be handled under newer Pharmacy dosage issues.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification Pharmacy issue asking to allow multiple Dosage dose representations by pulling DoseQuantity and RateQuantity into a repeating DoseAndRate backbone element and adding a coded type whose value set and binding were to be determined.
initial_application: The Jira comment says the change was applied in SVN build@13207 on 2018-02-25. Git history matches this with e60c66de120be04ca8911f07c85dd20fce48e5f9, whose message names GF 14212 and whose patch added Dosage.doseAndRate 0..*, Dosage.doseAndRate.type, dose[x], and rate[x] rows in source/datatypes/dosage.xml.
additional_context: The current build still lists Dosage as an active normative datatype owned by Pharmacy and published on the dosage page. Later related records clarify but do not reverse the change: FHIR-40217 corrected the type binding to http://terminology.hl7.org/ValueSet/dose-rate-type; FHIR-35896 clarified the doseAndRate description by containing resource; FHIR-15905 declined an invariant/comment for conflicting repeated entries; and a 2021 Zulip thread cited FHIR-14212 while explaining why the type binding remains example strength.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current authoritative source/datatypes/dosage.xml already contains the requested 0..* DoseAndRate structure and binding follow-up, with no source omission that would change implementer understanding.
